verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile the Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, mechanics, and Ultimate Finish condition. Preserve unresolved stamina/probability fields as null.
research_scope: Sledgehammer — Strike Super acquisition and mechanics research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository search results and seeded category membership with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Future Warrior skill documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Sledgehammer was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Sledgehammer as a Strike Super Attack with a hard-knockdown characteristic.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation lists the Skill Shop as the unlock route. Independent Future Warrior documentation lists Sledgehammer among Super Skills available to the Future Warrior.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented acquisition route is the Skill Shop rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because the reviewed sources do not establish a reliable canonical stamina value.

records.name: Sledgehammer
records.character_source: Multiple cast characters and customizable partners
records.skill_description: A chargeable Strike Super in which the user swings both hands downward to smash the opponent and knock them down.
records.mechanics_notes: The skill can be charged for increased damage and stronger knockdown. At maximum charge it can produce a hard knockdown and is documented as capable of breaking guard or hyper armor. Exact frame and damage values are not encoded because they are version-sensitive.
records.acquisition_notes: The current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation lists Skill Shop as the unlock route. No Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement is used for the canonical acquisition record.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; exact shop progression/availability timing is not promoted to a mandatory condition without stronger source evidence.
records.pvp_notes: The skill is documented as a fast uncharged knockdown option with stronger properties at higher charge levels; detailed matchup and frame claims remain version-sensitive.
